scripts.dev: node scripts/check-db-path.mjs && node scripts/auto-restore.mjs && node scripts/backup.mjs && node scripts/cleanup-uploads.mjs && next dev
scripts.start: node scripts/check-db-path.mjs && node scripts/auto-restore.mjs && node scripts/backup.mjs && prisma db push --skip-generate && node scripts/cleanup-uploads.mjs && next start
scripts.db:push: node scripts/check-db-path.mjs && node scripts/auto-restore.mjs && node scripts/backup.mjs && prisma db push
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
